# Command reference

Every `proxmox-lab` subcommand, generated from the parser. Flag-level
detail belongs to `--help` and the feature pages listed in
[README.md](README.md); this is the map.

## `proxmox-lab android`

Android devices as lab guests (emulated phones)

- `proxmox-lab android adb` — run an adb command
- `proxmox-lab android create` — build an Android device
- `proxmox-lab android profiles` — known device profiles
- `proxmox-lab android status` — is the device up?
- `proxmox-lab android template` — convert an already-built device to a template

## `proxmox-lab connection`

share connection settings and credentials with another controller

- `proxmox-lab connection export` — generate a private pasteable setup block including secrets
- `proxmox-lab connection import` — read a private JSON connection bundle from stdin

## `proxmox-lab console`

VNC, terminal and guest access

- `proxmox-lab console bridge` — expose a guest serial console on a local TCP port (debuggers)
- `proxmox-lab console click` — click at a pixel position
- `proxmox-lab console exec` — run a command via guest agent
- `proxmox-lab console has-gui-locked-up` — probe a graphical screen for a hang by moving the pointer
- `proxmox-lab console has-terminal-locked-up` — probe a text console for a hang by watching for any change
- `proxmox-lab console import-font` — removed: a screen is read by a vision model, not a font table
- `proxmox-lab console inspect` — inspect one lease-owned screenshot with cloud vision
- `proxmox-lab console keys` — send key combinations
- `proxmox-lab console preflight` — check console privileges and scratch storage
- `proxmox-lab console screenshot` — capture the screen as PNG
- `proxmox-lab console screenshot-burst` — capture several screenshots over time as one stitched PNG
- `proxmox-lab console text` — read the real terminal stream (exact characters)
- `proxmox-lab console type` — type text at the console

## `proxmox-lab crash`

offline, build-pinned crash address symbolization

- `proxmox-lab crash manifest-create` — hash local modules and record ASLR runtime mappings
- `proxmox-lab crash symbolize` — symbolize explicit addresses or crash-log frames locally

## `proxmox-lab disk`

offline guest-disk boot debugging and filesystem access

- `proxmox-lab disk boot-info` — parse MBR/GPT from a local image or a stopped guest's disk
- `proxmox-lab disk host-setup` — install libguestfs on the host (host change)
- `proxmox-lab disk ls` — list a directory in a stopped guest's filesystem
- `proxmox-lab disk read` — read a file from a stopped guest's filesystem
- `proxmox-lab disk write` — write a local file into a stopped guest (dangerous)

## `proxmox-lab doctor`

check config, secrets and access


## `proxmox-lab guest`

talk to a guest over any channel

- `proxmox-lab guest clone` — clone a lease-owned template into a new guest
- `proxmox-lab guest disk-activity` — is this guest really writing? (samples twice, compares signals)
- `proxmox-lab guest inventory` — every guest, its lease tag, and whether anything local owns it
- `proxmox-lab guest log` — print or stream the log of a detached guest run
- `proxmox-lab guest probe` — how can this guest be reached? (read-only)
- `proxmox-lab guest retain` — record an existing guest as deliberately kept (or --forget it)
- `proxmox-lab guest run` — run a command, picking the channel automatically
- `proxmox-lab guest snapshot` — create/list/rollback/delete Proxmox snapshots (kernel iteration)
- `proxmox-lab guest template` — convert a stopped lease-owned guest into a cloneable template
- `proxmox-lab guest wait` — wait for a detached guest run to exit and report its tail

## `proxmox-lab host`

read-only host hardware inspection (sensors, MACs)

- `proxmox-lab host macs` — list host network interfaces and MAC addresses
- `proxmox-lab host sensors` — read temperature sensors via the host SSH channel

## `proxmox-lab memflow`

agentless guest introspection with memflow (advanced)

- `proxmox-lab memflow analyze` — dump guest code and analyse it with Ghidra in the LXC
- `proxmox-lab memflow boot-diagnose` — diagnose a stuck boot from guest RAM (no agent, any guest OS)
- `proxmox-lab memflow break` — set a breakpoint, continue, and report where it stops
- `proxmox-lab memflow doctor` — prove the host is ready for introspection
- `proxmox-lab memflow dump` — extract a region of guest memory to a local file
- `proxmox-lab memflow ghidra-setup` — prepare a disposable LXC with Ghidra headless
- `proxmox-lab memflow host-setup` — install the memflow stack on the host (host change)
- `proxmox-lab memflow phys-read` — read raw bytes from guest physical RAM (any OS)
- `proxmox-lab memflow phys-write` — inject raw bytes into guest physical RAM (dangerous)
- `proxmox-lab memflow processes` — list a running guest's processes from outside it
- `proxmox-lab memflow read` — read raw bytes from guest kernel memory
- `proxmox-lab memflow registers` — report the guest's vCPU registers (via QEMU monitor)
- `proxmox-lab memflow scan` — search guest physical RAM for a byte signature
- `proxmox-lab memflow trace` — single-step the guest and disassemble each instruction
- `proxmox-lab memflow write` — write raw bytes into live guest memory (dangerous)

## `proxmox-lab net`

forced-VPN egress for lab guests

- `proxmox-lab net attach` — move a guest behind the gateway
- `proxmox-lab net dhcp-create` — spawn a lease-owned DHCP server (optional; dnsmasq)
- `proxmox-lab net dhcp-leases` — show the DHCP server's lease table
- `proxmox-lab net gateway-create` — build the VPN gateway VM
- `proxmox-lab net host-bridge` — create vmbr1 (host networking change)
- `proxmox-lab net leak-test` — prove a guest cannot reach the internet un-tunnelled
- `proxmox-lab net status` — show the lab network
- `proxmox-lab net tftp-create` — spawn a lease-owned TFTP server (optional; dnsmasq)
- `proxmox-lab net tftp-push` — stage a file into a TFTP server's root
- `proxmox-lab net verify` — prove egress uses the tunnel

## `proxmox-lab netcap`

network capture, SSL inspection and MITM relay

- `proxmox-lab netcap ca` — fetch the interception CA and print an OS install helper
- `proxmox-lab netcap capture` — capture a guest's traffic to a local pcap (passive)
- `proxmox-lab netcap doctor` — prove the MITM LXC is ready
- `proxmox-lab netcap intercept` — run the MITM proxy, decrypt flows, optionally rewrite
- `proxmox-lab netcap mitm-setup` — prepare a disposable LXC running mitmproxy

## `proxmox-lab oci`

experimental, low-isolation OCI image containers (PVE 9.1+)

- `proxmox-lab oci create` — create a lease-owned OCI LXC (experimental)
- `proxmox-lab oci pull` — pull a public OCI tag into template storage (experimental)
- `proxmox-lab oci validate` — check a reference offline and show the resulting template volume

## `proxmox-lab onboard`

Generate an installer and pair a new lab host (experimental)

- `proxmox-lab onboard accept`
- `proxmox-lab onboard build-iso`
- `proxmox-lab onboard discover`
- `proxmox-lab onboard prepare`
- `proxmox-lab onboard serve`

## `proxmox-lab pe`

inspect, extract, rebuild and boot a user-supplied Windows PE ISO

- `proxmox-lab pe boot` — upload a PE ISO and boot a lease-owned QEMU guest from it
- `proxmox-lab pe build` — rebuild a PE ISO with files added, removed, or a patched boot.wim (xorriso required)
- `proxmox-lab pe catalog` — report a PE ISO's boot record, boot.wim and tool tree
- `proxmox-lab pe extract` — extract a PE ISO's file tree and optionally apply its boot.wim

## `proxmox-lab share`

disposable links to a guest console, via noVNC

## `proxmox-lab storage`

physical disks and node storage

- `proxmox-lab storage add-disk` — format a disk and add it as directory storage
- `proxmox-lab storage download-url` — fetch an image into storage, checksum-verified

## `proxmox-lab usb`

USB passthrough and traffic sniffing

- `proxmox-lab usb attach` — pass a host USB device to a guest (passthrough change)
- `proxmox-lab usb detach` — remove a USB passthrough slot
- `proxmox-lab usb list` — list host USB devices and passthroughs
- `proxmox-lab usb sniff` — capture a device's USB traffic to a local pcap

## `proxmox-lab virtio`

diagnose virtio devices for driver porting and debugging

- `proxmox-lab virtio decode` — decode a virtio feature word offline (names every bit)
- `proxmox-lab virtio inspect` — report a running guest's virtio devices and negotiated features
- `proxmox-lab virtio monitor` — run one read-only virtio 'info' query against the guest monitor
- `proxmox-lab virtio queues` — sample one virtqueue through QEMU's read-only monitor

## `proxmox-lab windows`

install and set up Windows guests

- `proxmox-lab windows finish` — enable RDP/SSH and report IPs
- `proxmox-lab windows install` — clone and boot a Windows guest
- `proxmox-lab windows wait-agent` — wait for qemu-guest-agent
